There's probably a much better way to do it, and feel free to let me know, but this is what I did:

.word { visibility: hidden; }

.word:before { content: "whoaversers"; visibility: visible; }

Also, please forgive the formatting :)

Bonus: if you want to modify either "subscribers" or "users here now":

To change "subscribers" to [your call name for your subscribers]:

.subscribers .word { visibility: hidden; }
.subscribers .word:before { content: "[call name]"; visibility: visible; }

Just change [call name] with anything you want to call your subscribers.

And to change "users here now" to "Online users in WhoaVerse"

.users-online .word { visibility: hidden; }
.users-online .word:before { content: "Online users in WhoaVerse"; visibility: visible; }
